title: Hal Povenmire's visits from 2008 and his belief before he died in 2019 that the phenomenon was angelic

tellings.quote: But he said when I I know now to me it's um he believed it was angelic.

plain: A man named Hal Povenmire visited from 2008 on and, before he died in 2019, came to believe the phenomenon he had been studying was angelic. Chris Bledsoe, a man in Fayetteville, North Carolina, who says he has had repeated UFO encounters, relays what Povenmire told him. It matters because it shows someone close to the case seeing the visitors as spiritual rather than alien.
